claim: For every connected simple graph, one spanning tree simultaneously rounds every uniform-spanning-tree expected degree to its floor or ceiling.
method: Seeded random connected graphs, with edge probabilities selected from 0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, 0.50, 0.65, 0.75, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95; exact enumeration of all spanning trees and integer mean comparisons.
scope: Finite seeded sampling is not proof and does not imply coverage of all graph densities or structures.
